server.name: com.eaglevirtual/stablecoin-freeze-tracker
server.description: On-chain record of stablecoin freezes and seizures. Check any wallet: dated, cited, no risk scores.
server.title: Eagle Virtual — Stablecoin Freeze & Seize Tracker

com.eaglevirtual.authentication: Lazy: six tools are open with no account or key; watch_address alone challenges with HTTP 401 + WWW-Authenticate (resource_metadata at https://mcp.eaglevirtual.com/.well-known/oauth-protected-resource/mcp, scope watchlist:write). Authorization server https://eaglevirtual.com — OAuth 2.1, PKCE S256, client ID metadata documents, no dynamic client registration.
com.eaglevirtual.positioning: Reference data, not advice: dated on-chain records of actions stablecoin issuers took, a citation URL to eaglevirtual.com on every record, no risk scores or opinions about any address.
com.eaglevirtual.source: workers/mcp/server.json in the ev-simple repository (private; no repository field on purpose)

tools.name: get_address_status
tools.purpose: One wallet address in, every recorded blacklisting, freeze, seizure or on-chain sanctions listing against it out, with the transaction and block for each. Needs no account.

tools.name: get_token_statistics
tools.purpose: Counts of recorded events by coin, blockchain, month or year. Counts and dates only; no addresses.

tools.name: get_token_policy
tools.purpose: For a coin, which restriction controls the issuing company has actually used, how many times, and the first and most recent dates. No addresses.

tools.name: get_coverage
tools.purpose: The blockchains and coins covered, the date of the most recent recorded event, and any lane that cannot currently be vouched for.

tools.name: list_freeze_events
tools.purpose: The published feed of recent events — the same rows eaglevirtual.com shows — filterable by coin, blockchain, kind and date. A sample inside a six-month window; cannot be paged past.

tools.name: get_biggest
tools.purpose: The largest recorded blacklistings, freezes, seizures and releases, ranked by amount. The default six-month view names the wallet; scope all_time reaches back to 2018 and names no wallet, transaction or block.

tools.name: watch_address
tools.purpose: Saves one wallet address to the signed-in account. The only tool that writes and the only one that needs an account; saving the same address twice is a no-op.

com.eaglevirtual.authentication: None to start. All six tools only read, and one network address may make 100 calls a day with no account. A caller may send an Eagle Virtual API key as the bearer token to use that key's daily allowance. The events behind a month's totals are part of the Business plan.
com.eaglevirtual.positioning: Reference data, not advice: dated on-chain records of actions stablecoin issuers took, a citation URL to eaglevirtual.com on every record, no risk scores or opinions about any address.
com.eaglevirtual.source: workers/mcp/server.json in the ev-simple repository (private; no repository field on purpose)

tools.name: get_address_status
tools.purpose: One wallet address in, every recorded blacklisting, freeze, seizure or on-chain sanctions listing against it out, with the transaction and block for each. Needs no account.

tools.name: get_token_statistics
tools.purpose: Counts of recorded events by coin, blockchain, month or year. Counts and dates only; no addresses.

tools.name: get_token_policy
tools.purpose: For a coin, which restriction controls the issuing company has actually used, how many times, and the first and most recent dates. No addresses.

tools.name: get_coverage
tools.purpose: The blockchains and coins covered, the date of the most recent recorded event, and any lane that cannot currently be vouched for.

tools.name: list_freeze_events
tools.purpose: The published feed of recent events — the same rows eaglevirtual.com shows — filterable by coin, blockchain, kind and date. A published sample that cannot be paged past. Give it a month for that month's totals, and the events behind them on the Business plan.

tools.name: get_biggest
tools.purpose: The largest recorded blacklistings, freezes, seizures and releases, ranked by amount. The default view ranks the 25 latest recorded events and names the wallet; scope all_time covers the whole record back to 2015 and names no wallet, transaction or block.
